newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize, soy down after CBOT.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize, soy down after CBOT.

text.p: Argentine cash new crop maize followed Chicago lower in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

Spot cash maize was mixed, with local buyers and some exporters in the market. January wheat was steady in middling trade, with the export market providing little support. Traders said a recent sale to Algeria was made on the cheap side at $145 FOB. Cash soybeans slumped in Chicago's slipstream. Spot turnover was medium, but new crop volume was good. Sunflower seed was unchanged in good volume. There was plenty of supply and southern crushers were buying.
